scene: The vibrating meter pinpoints three distinct broadcast signals humming right outside.
picture: Side-view cross-section through the repair shop's open garage wall. The player stands inside clutching the brass meter. Far left, a yellow window-cleaner gondola dangles from roof cables. Centre, an open postal portal shows a small red mail train idling. Right, a teal tow truck idles curbside with hazard lights flashing.
shown: a yellow window-cleaner gondola resting on cables outside on the far left
a tiny red pneumatic mail train paused on rails in the centre
a turquoise flatbed tow truck with blinking lights parked on the right
